items.summary: CTO review: hold the aliencouncil.com affiliate prototype this cycle. The hypothesis is technically feasible as a native, page-local HTML/CSS change with existing links and instrumentation, but the current evidence does not establish lift, attributable revenue, margin, or causal impact. Active measurement and repair backlog, unavailable operations/fleet-doctor evidence, and unknown page-level conflicts make safe queue entry premature. Preserve the proposal for re-evaluation after backlog clearance; no dependency, telemetry, credential, DNS, schedule, spend, or cross-site change is authorized.

Technical disposition: if reconsidered, route only a single-page native HTML/CSS prototype through an isolated worktree. Require focused build/tests, rendered mobile accessibility validation, affiliate-link and disclosure checks, deployment verification, and page-only rollback. Use only existing available measurements; record unknowns rather than infer revenue, ROI, incrementality, or infrastructure cost. Measure for 14 days or 100 new impressions, whichever comes later, subject to the existing measurement queue.

Hold the prototype. If reconsidered, use one isolated page-local native HTML/CSS change with existing links and instrumentation. Require build, accessibility, disclosure, deployment, rollback, and measurement evidence. No new dependencies, telemetry, credentials, DNS, schedule, spend, or cross-site changes.
